current_command.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; Write-Output '=== ACTIVE NETWORK ==='; Get-NetConnectionProfile | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,NetworkCategory,IPv4Connectivity,IPv6Connectivity | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '=== REMOTE SHUTDOWN RULE DETAILS ==='; $rs=Get-NetFirewallRule -PolicyStore ActiveStore | Where-Object {$_.DisplayGroup -eq 'Remote Shutdown'}; foreach($r in $rs){$pf=$r | Get-NetFirewallPortFilter; $sf=$r | Get-NetFirewallServiceFilter; [pscustomobject]@{Name=$r.DisplayName;Enabled=$r.Enabled;Direction=$r.Direction;Action=$r.Action;Profile=$r.Profile;Protocol=$pf.Protocol;LocalPort=($pf.LocalPort -join ',');Service=$sf.Service}} | Format-List; Write-Output '=== OTHER ENABLED INBOUND RULES ON TCP 135 / RPC ==='; $all=Get-NetFirewallRule -PolicyStore ActiveStore -Enabled True -Direction Inbound -Action Allow; foreach($r in $all){$pf=$r|Get-NetFirewallPortFilter; if(($pf.Protocol -eq 'TCP') -and (($pf.LocalPort -contains '135') -or ($pf.LocalPort -contains 'RPC') -or ($pf.LocalPort -contains 'RPC-EPMap'))){$sf=$r|Get-NetFirewallServiceFilter; [pscustomobject]@{Name=$r.DisplayName;Group=$r.DisplayGroup;Profile=$r.Profile;LocalPort=($pf.LocalPort -join ',');Service=$sf.Service}}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '=== CURRENT PROFILE POLICY ==='; netsh advfirewall show currentprofile | Select-String -Pattern 'State|Firewall Policy|InboundUserNotification|LocalFirewallRules'"
